scope: HFSS translation assumptions shared by the three Kaur 2021 cases

assumed.coordinate_convention: substrate lower-left=(-9,0,0), feed points in +y, metal lies on z=h
assumed.vertical_connectivity: feed end y=LF touches stub bottom; stub top y=LF+Y1 touches patch bottom
assumed.srs_center: on x=0 at the lower patch edge
assumed.srs_split: centred at the bottom of the circular slot
assumed.port: XZ 50-ohm lumped-port sheet spans the 2.1 mm CPW centre opening at y=0; the integration line runs from x=0.6 to x=1.05 mm at z=h

unresolved_from_paper: vertical patch placement and exact SRS centre coordinates
SMA connector and CPW port dimensions
mesh operations and adaptive convergence settings
frequency sampling used for the published curves
numeric simulated and measured S-parameter data
case_isolation: wlan_notch contains only R1=2.4 mm, R2=2.1 mm, S1=0.4 mm
xband_notch contains only R1_prime=2.1 mm, R2_prime=1.6 mm, S1_prime=0.4 mm
acceptance_policy: The baseline must remain matched at VSWR <= 2 over 3-12 GHz.
A notched case is checked for matching outside its target rejection interval only.
Inside the rejection interval, the inequality is reversed: VSWR must remain >= 2, equivalently dB(S11) >= -9.542425 dB.
A failed local paper gate triggers review of labelled assumptions; paper-explicit dimensions must never be silently changed.
